tasks.prompt: Add a focused validation test for the smallest existing utility that lacks direct coverage. Do not change production behavior outside the test.
acceptance: diff is limited to the target test surface

tasks.prompt: Update one API or README section to document an existing behavior. Preserve headings and links.
Reproduce a supplied failing test, identify the smallest root-cause fix, implement it, and add a regression test.
Add one backward-compatible API field, validate malformed input, update the contract documentation, and test both old and new shapes.
acceptance: new response is documented and tested

tasks.prompt: Review a bounded authentication or data-handling change for security regressions and produce an actionable patch with tests.
Audit a release candidate against its stated acceptance contract and produce a verified go/no-go report.
acceptance: unavailable checks are not marked pass
